value.italian_proof: B2 certificate of Italian issued by a CLIQ body, required before enrolment (alternatives: Italian/San Marino/Ticino citizenship, or an upper-secondary qualification obtained in Italian)
value.english_admission_requirement: none - English is not an admission requirement for Italian-taught Laurea programmes; if not proved, the OFA ENG (additional educational obligation) is assigned. Certificates that clear the OFA: TOEFL iBT >= 45, IELTS >= 4, TOEIC L&R >= 550 (from 1 March 2026), Cambridge >= B1 Preliminary, OTE >= 81, or >= 24/30 correct in the TENG/TOL English section.

english.quote: an appropriate certification of Italian language proficiency at level B2 from the CLIQ
english.how_found: Engineering admission page -> link "Language requirements" (https://www.polimi.it/en/students/language-requirements) -> link "Italian-taught Laurea programmes".
english.notes: Page is headed "Equivalent to Bachelor of Science - Academic year 2026/2027". Italian: "you must demonstrate Knowledge of the Italian language before enrolment." English, verbatim from the same page: "Knowledge of the English language is not a requirement for admission to courses taught in Italian"; without proof "you will be assigned the English OFA (OFA ENG)". The Engineering admission page (https://www.polimi.it/en/prospective-students/how-to-apply/admission-to-laurea-programmes/engineering) confirms: "B2 level certification of proficiency in the Italian language issued by the CLIQ." and "Proficiency in English is not an entry requirement, but it is necessary to continue and complete your Laurea". The TOL >= 30/100 route as Italian proof applies only to English-taught programmes. The applicant (Kazakhstan NIS diploma, non-Italian-medium) must therefore hold a B2 Italian certificate before enrolling. 2027/28 rules not yet published; recorded from the 2026/27 cycle.

value.description: No diploma-grade/GPA threshold is published. Admission to engineering Laurea programmes is by entrance test (TOL, or alternative TOLC-I / CEnT-S / SAT converted to TOL score) and a ranking against available places (735 for Ingegneria Informatica at Milano Leonardo, 125 at Cremona). Minimum TOL score to be considered in the ranking list (rounded): 30/100; maximum 100. Being above 30/100 does not guarantee a place.

gpa.quote: The minimum score obtained at the TOL taken in 2026, to be considered in the formulation of the ranking list, rounded to the nearest whole number, must be equal to or greater than 30/100.
gpa.how_found: Engineering admission page -> link "Scores and rankings".
gpa.notes: Academic year 2026/2027 page. Same page: "The maximum score that can be achieved is 100.00."; English OFA: "considering the English section alone, the number of correct answers is less than 24."; ranking: "The rankings are drawn up on the basis of the best TOL score and alternative test score". For the 2027/28 intake the 'When to register for the tests' page says Early-TOL candidates (penultimate year) with a rounded score of 75/100 or higher are eligible for Italian-taught courses in A.Y. 2027/2028, and "More information will be available around January 2027." Available places: https://www.polimi.it/en/prospective-students/how-to-apply/admission-to-laurea-programmes/available-places (735 Milano Leonardo / 125 Cremona / 150 online, per search result). The recorded threshold is a test score, not a GPA.

deadline.quote: The submission of the student visa application on the Universitaly portal for the 2026/2027 a.y. must be completed as soon as possible and, in any case, within August 31st, 2026.
deadline.how_found: Web search: "polimi.it international prospective students Laurea \"Bachelor of Science\" how to apply non-EU citizens residing abroad Universitaly pre-enrolment deadline" -> result "How to apply for a student visa - polimi" (also linked from 'Students with a foreign qualification' page).
deadline.notes: ONLY THE 2026/27 CYCLE IS PUBLISHED; the 2027/28 bachelor dates are not yet online ("More information will be available around January 2027." on the test-dates page). The recorded date is the non-EU-specific deadline: Universitaly pre-enrolment/visa submission for "Non-EU citizens living abroad who are accepted to our Bachelor degree programmes must create an account on Universitaly and submit their visa application." Polimi "will confirm the pre-enrolment to the Italian Diplomatic Representative via the Universitaly platform only if the entrance test has been passed". Earlier binding steps in the 2026/27 cycle (same procedure for EU and non-EU): TOL Standard registration "from 1/02/2026 to 10/03/2026" and "from 11/03/2026 to 31/05/2026" (https://www.polimi.it/en/prospective-students/how-to-apply/admission-to-laurea-programmes/engineering/when-to-register-for-the-tol); TOLC-I/CEnT-S results registered by 4 June 2026; early enrolment phase "from 10:30 am (CEST) on 4 May until 11:59 pm (CEST) on 11 June 2026", later ranking/enrolment rounds through 9 September 2026 (https://www.polimi.it/en/prospective-students/how-to-apply/admission-to-laurea-programmes/engineering/when-to-enrol/you-take-a-test-and-you-are-in-the-last-year). Expect analogous dates roughly Feb-Aug 2027 for the 2027/28 intake, to be confirmed in January 2027.

value.population: maximum all-inclusive contribution (highest ISEE bracket), Laurea/LM/single-cycle; charged automatically to students who do not submit an ISEE/ISEEU parificato - i.e. the standard full fee for a non-EU student residing abroad who does not obtain an ISEEU parificato

tuition.quote: gradually increases up to a maximum of € 3,943.04.
tuition.how_found: Web search: "Politecnico di Milano tuition fees non-EU students Laurea 2026/27 contribution maximum amount" -> result "Laurea, Laurea Magistrale and Single-cycle programmes - polimi" (also linked as "Costi e borse" from the programme page).
tuition.notes: Page heading: "You are a future student of the 2026/2027 academic year." 2027/28 fees are not published. Fee is income-banded: "For a standard study plan of between 46 and 74 ECTS and an ISEE of up to € 22,000, the amount is € 157.04" up to the maximum of € 3,943.04 for a 46-74 ECTS plan; paid as a first instalment ("you will need to pay the first instalment of €880.04 upon enrolment.") plus a second instalment ("The second instalment ranges from €0 to €3,003 (for a study plan including between 46 and 74 ECTS credits)"). "The maximum amount is automatically charged to students:" ... "without an ISEE certificate who decide not to submit one". The explicit rule that non-EU students always pay the maximum even with an ISEEU parificato is stated for the reserved non-EU Laurea Magistrale category, not for Laurea: a non-EU bachelor student with income abroad may request the ISEEU parificato from the CAF affiliated with Politecnico to be placed in a lower bracket (https://www.polimi.it/en/students/tuition-fees-scholarships-and-financial-aid/tuition-fees/students-with-income-and-property-abroad). Regional tax (max €190) and stamp duty (€16.00) are extra. Previous year (2025/26) maximum was € 3,893.04 per search snippet.

scholarship_exists.quote: Students admitted to a Bachelor of Science programme can apply for Diritto allo Studio (DSU) Scholarships
scholarship_exists.how_found: Web search: "Politecnico di Milano scholarships international students Laurea bachelor merit-based" -> result "Scholarships - polimi" (prospective students > How much does it cost > Scholarships).
scholarship_exists.notes: DSU is the Politecnico-administered right-to-education scholarship (income- and merit-based; "Every year, in June, PoliMi publishes a special Call for the assignment of 'DSU' Benefits." - https://www.polimi.it/en/students/tuition-fees-scholarships-and-financial-aid/university-financial-aid-diritto-allo-studio-universitario-dsu). For first-year students "only income will be considered at first step". Call PDF 2026/27: https://www.polimi.it/fileadmin/user_upload/studenti/tasse-borse-agevolazioni-economiche/dsu/bando_2026-2027/DSU_Call_a.y._2026-2027.pdf (not text-extractable by the fetch tool; search snippets indicate 250 scholarships for first-year BSc/single-cycle students, first-year application deadline 5 August 2026, ISEEU parificato limit € 26,887.93). Polimi's 'Merit-based scholarships' (Platinum/Gold) are for international candidates admitted to Laurea Magistrale programmes only. The 'Cremona and Piacenza Scholarships' are explicitly "Scholarships for Bachelor of Science programs are available for international students" but cover only BSc Process Engineering (Cremona) and BSc Industrial Engineering (Piacenza), not Ingegneria Informatica (https://www.polimi.it/en/prospective-students/how-much-does-it-cost/scholarships/cremona-and-piacenza-scholarships). No Polimi merit scholarship specifically for international bachelor applicants to Ingegneria Informatica is published.

scholarship_international.quote: Students with income and assets (movable and immovable) declared and/or owned abroad or in Italy and abroad enrolled in the first year of Laurea (equivalent to Bachelor of Science) and in Laurea Magistrale who have been granted student bursaries for the right to education in A.Y. 2026/2027
scholarship_international.how_found: Cost page (Laurea, LM and single-cycle programmes) -> link "Students with income and property abroad".
scholarship_international.notes: EVIDENCE QUALITY: the HTML pages do not use the word 'international' for DSU; the quoted sentence (Academic Year 2026/2027) shows that first-year Laurea students whose household income/assets are abroad - the situation of a non-EU applicant from Kazakhstan - are granted DSU right-to-education bursaries, and must prove income via the "ISEEU parificato" obtained from the CAF affiliated with Politecnico ("If you have income or assets abroad (*), for the calculation of your university fees you must request the document known as the ISEEU parificato from the affiliated CAF"). The explicit nationality wording is in the DSU Call 2026/27 PDF, which the fetch tool could not text-extract; search-engine snippets of that call read "Any student - Italian or foreign - with income and assets abroad, or both abroad and in Italy, may not request the ISEE certification. Rather, they need to obtain a substitute document known as the 'ISEEU Parificato'" (NOT verified verbatim by me). The only published exclusion found concerns exchange students enrolled at a foreign university. Eligibility is income-capped (ISEEU parificato limit per the call) and, from the 2027/28 call, foreign financial documents are to be checked against a minimum household-resources threshold (per search snippet, unverified). Verify directly in the 2027/28 DSU call when published (June 2027).
